plan: Given my value of $15, I should aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize potential profit while minimizing risk. Since I gain nothing if I lose, bidding too low might result in not winning. I will bid $14.9 to ensure I have a high chance of winning if others bid close to their values. This strategy balances winning probability and profit maximization.

Since bids are in $0.1 increments, I will bid slightly lower than my value to ensure a positive gain if I win. Bidding $35.9 ensures I don't exceed my value, and I only pay the third-highest bid. This strategy balances the chance of winning with a reasonable profit margin.
